steps.text: Bring travel money: 60 gold for each try.
Ask Captain Fearless in Venore for a passage to Darashia. One time in ten the ghostship takes you; otherwise try again.
steps.source: Go to Venore boat, and travel Venore→Darashia until you are hijacked by the Ghostship.

steps.text: Go down and fight your way across the gangplank to the southern boat (ghosts).
steps.source: Go down and fight your way across the gangplank to the southern boat.

steps.text: Go down the western ladder: you land on a fire field.
steps.source: Go down to 2 vampires, 1 demon skeleton and a ghost. Warning: when you go down you will land on a fire field.

steps.text: Kill the ghoul and the ghost.
steps.source: Go down to 2 vampires, 1 demon skeleton and a ghost. Kill them.

steps.text: Use the coffin on the east: a plate armor.
steps.source: Kill them and use the coffin on the east to receive your reward.
